categories.legacy-16bit: Windows 3.x and 9x: the 16-bit modules, VxDs and Win32s old programs and installers load
categories.drivers: Kernel-mode drivers: the device, bus, file system and network stacks under Windows
categories.core: The NT layer, the Win32 base and the WoW64 and CPU emulation layers every program runs on
categories.directx-graphics: Direct3D 1 to 12, DirectDraw, DXGI, Direct2D, the D3DX libraries and the shader compilers
categories.directx-audio: DirectSound, XAudio2, X3DAudio, XAPOFX, XACT and DirectMusic
categories.directx-input: DirectInput, XInput, GameInput and game controllers
categories.directx-media: DirectShow, Media Foundation, Video for Windows and the codecs they use
categories.translation-layers: DXVK and VKD3D-Proton: Direct3D 8 to 12 drawn with Vulkan
categories.gaming: The Game Explorer, Game Bar and the other parts of Windows that are there for games
categories.audio: Windows audio outside DirectX: the multimedia API, MCI, the audio endpoints, speech and the Switch audio driver
categories.imaging-text: GDI+, the image codecs, fonts, text layout and code pages
categories.c-runtime: The C and C++ runtimes: MSVCRT, the Visual C++ redistributables, the UCRT, ATL and MFC
categories.dotnet: .NET: the runtime host Mono or .NET is loaded through
categories.com-ole: COM, OLE, Automation and the script engines
categories.winrt: The Windows Runtime and its Windows.* components
categories.data: Databases: ODBC, ADO, OLE DB, the ESE engine and SQLite
categories.network: Sockets, HTTP, the Internet APIs, telephony, wireless and directory services
categories.shell-ui: The shell, common controls and dialogs, themes, input, accessibility and the browser control
categories.installers: Installing and updating: Windows Installer, cabinets, patches, side-by-side and Windows Update
categories.programs: Windows programs: the command prompt, Notepad, the registry editor and the rest
categories.system: The rest of Windows: services, event logs, performance counters, WMI and devices
